parameters.unit: a constants-verbatim (n_lifted = 0) pattern that is a rooted tree: atoms as edges centre -> other arguments, unary atoms as attributes, one root, every other node under exactly one parent; joins excluded
parameters.closure: closed = no larger faithful unit with the same supporting records CONTAINS it (atoms embed under a variable renaming); different units on the same records are both closed; every size-k unit is closed by construction; computed within the view (the miner's dominated flag, whole inventory incl. lifted + joins, kept as miner_dominated only)
parameters.meta_node: (Mn<Name> <root> <other variables>) for units of size >= 2; Name = batch-1 style, built along the tree (heads/constants in atom order, Ev/Fn for event/function fillers, Of<spec> for a filler with its own atoms, Neg for ~NEG; root tokens joined with '_', tokens inside a nested spec with '-'); pattern id appended only on a residual collision (2 units on H, 0 on item-E); provisional
parameters.excluded: constant-lifted shape stratum (addition) and joins (cross-star capability, addition)
parameters.owner_decisions_2026-09-08: lifted patterns and joins = additions arm; rooted subtree = directed, one parent per node (undirected reading would admit 221 of 275 joins; 54 cyclic under any reading); k = 4 kept for production; example sentences kept in the report
parameters.proposals: closed units of size >= 2 (JSONL flag `proposal`; 728 on H, 614 on item-E); a subsumed unit is the same evidence in fewer atoms and is rendered for reading only, naming its cover; single-atom units are subtrees by the letter, kept in the JSONL and counts, not rendered (a one-atom pack is a rename)

4.3.3_mutual_information.input: mining/out_h/patterns2_faithful.jsonl (the faithful §4.3.1 units = the binary subtree x sentence matrix)

faithful.gate: raw MI >= threshold AND both supports <= ceiling (the paper's two clauses on the paper's statistic)

parameters.MI: exact pairwise MI of the binary presence variables, bits, raw
parameters.threshold: MI of a perfect co-occurrence over 7 records = H(7/N) = 0.0298 bits on H (--mi-anchor-records 7; ~6x the Bonferroni level 0.0053); near-miss value = 5 records; recording floor = 3 records
parameters.ceiling: 97th percentile of unit support = 27 records on H (1.2%), 12 on item-E (--cap-percentile 97; --support-cap-frac overrides)
parameters.calibration: ceiling x threshold table with median Jaccard of the passes; the claim holds only near a 1% ceiling; the record-count anchor keeps the perfectly co-occurring support-3..5 paraphrase pairs out (the claim alone would accept 0.015 bits)
parameters.jaccard: reported as the paper's consequence, not gated
parameters.record: one record per passing pair: units, record counts + distinct sentences behind the shared records, MI, Jaccard, variable alignment found by matching both units in every shared record (holds-in count), merged feature, and the pack rule (Implication (And <merged>) (Mn<Name> <vars>)); flags: contained (= part-of), no shared skolem; kinds and families dropped (owner 2026-09-09)
